The closing guitar run of "Sultans of Swing".
Full song: https://www.battleofthetechbands.com/go/8YIPtpb5-0s/fb-caption

Total Loss from Suncorp take Dire Straits home at The Triffid, red Strat out front. They'd been playing together for 12 years, and this was their first Battle of the Tech Bands.

Video shot by Aaron Griffiths and Kurt Boldy. Live audio by Nick Forrester.

Proudly powered by Jumbo Interactive. All proceeds to Youngcare, supporting young Australians with high care needs to live with more choice, freedom and dignity.
